observation.visible_scene: Nighttime outdoor scene on a dim reddish-brown ground (sand/dirt). A silhouetted person stands near the center with both arms raised overhead, holding a point that continuously throws off a wide fan of bright orange-yellow sparks, forming an arcing canopy of sparks above and around them. A dark rock sits to the left on the ground, and a thin vertical trail of sparks plus a small glowing patch lie below the person's feet. Individual elongated spark streaks fall through the frame against the black background.
visible_changes: The overhead spray of sparks from the raised hands persists and flickers throughout, spreading outward in an arc; it is already in progress at the first frame and still ongoing at the last.
A bright, elongated spark streak on the right side descends from the upper-right corner toward the lower-right over the sequence, while other small sparks drift downward across the frame.
The person stays standing with arms up, showing only slight sway/rotation of the torso and arms rather than large displacement.
Ground spark clusters near the feet and lower center remain present, flickering in intensity.

Framing shifts gradually: the left rock and ground features move relative to the image edges and the subject occupies slightly more of the frame, indicating a slow camera zoom/pan rather than subject translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the person is holding and the mechanism or material producing the sparks (not visible).
Whether the spark emission began before the clip or continues after it.
The full shape and extent of the spark pattern outside the frame.
uncertain_details: Direction and magnitude of camera motion are uncertain given the mostly black background.
Whether the glowing patches on the ground are landed sparks or reflections is not determinable.
The exact nature of the body motion (rotation vs. slight sway) is hard to resolve from the silhouetted pose.
